title: Exploration of geo-spatial data and machine learning algorithms for robust wildfire occurrence prediction
summary: Full PMC article develops a regional wildfire-occurrence pipeline combining geospatial, meteorological and anthropogenic features with multiple ML/DL models; regional F1 scores range 0.70–0.87. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology

evidence.tested: Full PMC article develops a regional wildfire-occurrence pipeline combining geospatial, meteorological and anthropogenic features with multiple ML/DL models; regional F1 scores range 0.70–0.87.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: Random Forest, XGBoost, autoencoder, ConvLSTM, attention MLP and RegNetX predict five-day wildfire occurrence from environmental data.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
